context_requirements: Expression of LPL or PPARA in the cell line
Functional PPAR-alpha signaling and RXR availability
Presence of lipoprotein/triglyceride substrate for LPL-mediated fatty acid release
Hepatic or lipid-metabolizing lineage for strongest transcriptional response
falsifiers: No change in PPARA target genes or lipid metabolism genes at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line
Strong induction of cholesterol biosynthesis genes (e.g., HMGCR, HMGCS1) rather than repression
Consistent strong transcriptional response across all nine lines, including non-hepatic lines, at 6 h
No difference in response between HEPG2 and non-hepatic lines
